message.content:
**1) Asymmetric Balance:**
The composition is **well-balanced but slightly heavy on the right (text side)**. In an RTL layout, the text block on the right acts as a strong visual anchor. The orbital visual on the left is elegant and thematic, but it feels a bit "light" in terms of visual mass compared to the dense, high-contrast white typography. It works, but it leans toward a "text-dominant" layout rather than a perfect 50/50 visual weight distribution.

**2) Typography Hierarchy:**
**Excellent.** 
*   **H1 ("نحو نقطة توازن"):** Bold, massive, and immediately commanding. Perfect for a hero.
*   **Pill Badge:** Effectively sets the context before the headline.
*   **Body Text:** Good contrast and readability against the dark background.
*   **Micro-copy/Labels:** The "EST. MXXV", "KNOWLEDGE · ORBIT", and "SCROLL" elements add a sophisticated, technical "blueprint" feel that reinforces the academic/luxury brand.

**3) Clipping/Overflow/Misalignment:**
*   **Alignment:** Generally solid. The text block is cleanly aligned to the right (RTL standard).
*   **Clipping:** No obvious clipping of text or main UI elements.
*   **Minor Issue:** The bottom-most text line ("متاح للباحثين...") and the footer coordinates feel very close to the edge. Ensure there is adequate padding at the bottom viewport edge so it doesn't feel "cut off" on shorter screens.

**4) Visual Polish & Improvement:**
**Rating: 8/10**

**Most Impactful Improvement:**
**Enhance the "Orbital" Visual Depth.** Currently, the left-side graphic is flat (2D lines and dots). To match the "Premium Dark-Luxury" brief, add **subtle 3D depth**—give the rings a slight bevel/glow, add a soft radial gradient behind the central icon to make it look like a glowing celestial body, and use parallax or a gentle float animation. This will balance the heavy text on the right and elevate the entire design from "clean template" to "high-end digital experience."
